:::{#thm-simplification}
#### Simplification

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $P$ and $Q$,
this is a [rule of inference](#def-rule-of-inference):

$$
\frac{P \land Q}{P}
$$

:::

::: proof

Suppose the [premise](#def-premise) is true.
By the definition of [and](#def-and),
$P \land Q$ is true
only if $P$ and $Q$ are both true.
So the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) $P$ is true.

:::
